How we hire engineers

Our process has four stages and usually takes three weeks.

  1. Recruiter call (30 minutes): your background and what you want next.
  2. Take-home exercise (about 3 hours): build a small telemetry ingestion API. We review it before the next round.
  3. System design interview (60 minutes): design a system that stores and queries rocket telemetry at scale.
  4. Values interview (45 minutes) with two engineers: written communication, ownership and how you handle incidents.

We never ask brain-teasers or whiteboard trivia.
